declarations.rationale: Mixed explicit chair, leader, president and subcommittee head forms the coherent organizational-leadership family; ordinary membership and partnership alone remain excluded.

Parent approved unresolved tie after full rows: two research-topic paths, two industry descriptors, two spokesperson paths, two corporate containment paths and one clear minister title. All paths singleton; no unique specific meaning or interpretable tie-break.
Wainwright House geographic venue/address family dominates; coach-player interactions and a sports president role remain distinct.
Specific county executive title family dominates; executive-elect and counterpart alone do not automatically establish tenure.
Three professor paths tie director/head/oversight contexts; the two-count explicit professor-at path resolves the tie over management singletons.

World Series appearance/seeing/swept/winning family dominates; outcomes differ but coherent sporting-event participation underlies it. Corporate unit and securities filing remain separate.
Four ambassador-to rows establish the largest specific international-relation family; military war and inverse spokesperson are distinct.

Adviser title family dominates explicit roles; director, athletic opposition and a meeting alone are distinct.
